compile_note: GAP -- PREDICTED FALSE BLOCK. Intent includes a ~2000 paise goodwill amount that corresponds to no line item, so the line-item policy cannot express it. intent_text: The customer is a long-standing account and the merchant wants a goodwill gesture on top of the 12000 paise refund for the broken jar -- roughly 2000 paise as an apology. The dry fruits are undamaged and must not be refunded.
